product_summary: No public product page, website or catalogue could be opened for this company. Search engines returned no relevant hits for the exact legal name (DuckDuckGo backend refused connections; Bing returned unrelated results; Zauba/CompanyCheck/IndiaMART returned 403/429). The only product evidence available is the company's own name: 'MATCHES' — i.e. matches/matchboxes, which in the Indian tariff is HS 3605 00 00 (matches, other than Bengal lights/pyrotechnic articles of 3604). Nothing on the record supports incense sticks, agarbatti, perfumed burning preparations or other goods of heading 3307.
comment: HS 330741 (agarbatti and other odoriferous preparations which operate by burning) is inconsistent with the company name, which points to matches (HS 3605). Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: the company is retained and the code is corrected to 3605 00. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the correction rests solely on the trade name — no website, catalogue, product listing or customs line could be retrieved (all registry/aggregator sources blocked: Zauba 403, CompanyCheck 403, IndiaMART 429; search backend down). Therefore the actual product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' and the HS 3605 mapping must be treated as provisional until a catalogue or a customs line is seen. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' also looks misclassified: matches are a pyrotechnic/consumer-goods item, not food or FMCG food. No trader signs could be assessed (no product pages). No revenue, volume, CIN or shipment data researched per role scope; all such fields null.
